run_merge_llm_adapter: run the autotrain tools merge-llm-adapter command to merge a base model with its adapter
run_convert_to_kohya: run the autotrain tools convert_to_kohya command to convert a model to Kohya format
register_subcommand_tools: register the autotrain tools subcommand parser with merge-llm-adapter and convert_to_kohya subcommands
run_tools_command_factory: create a RunAutoTrainToolsCommand instance from parsed CLI arguments for tool execution
run_tools_command: run the RunAutoTrainToolsCommand to execute merge llm adapter or convert to kohya tools
